# The Markup

> A nonprofit newsroom producing investigative journalism exposing how technology companies collect data, enable surveillance, and perpetuate algorithmic bias.

The Markup combines deep investigative reporting with public accountability tools like Blacklight and Citizen Browser to investigate corporate practices at Amazon, Meta, Google, and other tech giants. Their work spans antitrust violations, privacy violations, racial disparities in algorithmic systems, and digital access inequities.

## Key Topics

- Investigative journalism
- Data privacy
- Antitrust
- Algorithmic bias
- Consumer protection

## Investigation Series

- [Amazon's Advantage](https://themarkup.org/series/amazons-advantage): Investigation of Amazon's antitrust practices and self-preferencing in search rankings and private-label brands
- [Organ Failure](https://themarkup.org/series/organ-failure): Investigation of racial disparities in organ transplant allocation and UNOS policies
- [Pixel Hunt](https://themarkup.org/series/pixel-hunt): Investigation of Meta pixel tracking in health data sharing practices and privacy violations
- [Privacy](https://themarkup.org/series/privacy): Investigations of data brokers, surveillance capitalism, and consumer privacy violations
- [Languages of Misinformation](https://themarkup.org/series/languages-of-misinformation): Investigation of misinformation targeting non-English speaking communities
- [Still Loading](https://themarkup.org/series/still-loading): Investigation of digital divide and broadband access disparities across America
- [Machine Learning](https://themarkup.org/series/machine-learning): Investigation of AI and algorithmic bias in education technology systems
- [Working for an Algorithm](https://themarkup.org/series/working-for-an-algorithm): Investigation of algorithmic management and worker surveillance in gig economy platforms

## Public Accountability Tools

- [Blacklight](https://themarkup.org/series/blacklight): Privacy inspection tool for detecting website tracking, data collection, and surveillance technologies
- [Citizen Browser](https://themarkup.org/series/citizen-browser): Platform accountability tool investigating Facebook ad targeting practices and algorithmic amplification
